name: omni-agi-studio
description: A cross-platform studio for building persistent, adaptive OmniCortex research models.
author: Omni-AGI contributors

scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:python
scripts.test:node:ci: vitest run tests/actionProtocol.test.ts tests/brainProvenancePresentation.test.ts tests/buildResourceSelections.test.ts tests/chatLoadingPresentation.test.ts tests/engineSupervisor.test.ts tests/mediaProtocol.test.ts tests/mobileTlsIdentity.test.ts tests/mobileTransportSecurity.test.ts tests/packagedCompliance.test.ts tests/platformChrome.test.ts tests/projectIntegrity.test.ts tests/releasePackaging.test.ts tests/releaseRuntimeCompatibility.test.ts tests/resourcePlanRequest.test.ts tests/resourcePlanner.test.ts tests/ramFirstNativeSizing.test.ts tests/shutdownIpcLifecycle.test.ts tests/uiDefectRegression.test.ts tests/uiVisualIntegrity.test.ts tests/chatNoReplyCompletion.test.ts tests/codecRuntimeBridge.test.ts tests/conceptIdViews.test.ts tests/cortexViewerContracts.test.ts tests/evolutionIntentAuthority.test.ts tests/nativeArchitectureMath.test.ts tests/nativeComputeMeasurement.test.ts tests/managedWorkerMemory.test.ts tests/neuralSpeechProduction.test.ts tests/runtimeSettingsShape.test.ts tests/savedToolIntents.test.ts tests/toolIntentJournal.test.ts tests/inlineCancellationTransport.test.ts tests/steeredReceiptPresentation.test.ts tests/architectureMutation.test.ts tests/crawlSourceLease.test.ts tests/crawlCompletionContract.test.ts tests/videoRuntimeManifestLineEndings.test.ts tests/videoRuntimeProvisioner.test.ts tests/videoRuntimeSupervisor.test.ts tests/warmSteerBoundary.test.ts --maxWorkers=2 --testTimeout=30000

scripts.test:ui:contract: playwright test tests/e2e/appearance.spec.ts tests/e2e/chat-ui-contract.spec.ts tests/e2e/imagination-gallery.spec.ts tests/e2e/responsive.spec.ts tests/e2e/theme-matrix.spec.ts --config playwright.config.ts

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio uses the microphone only after you start Live Voice, for continuous speech recognition and barge-in.
extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio uses the camera only after you start Live Perception, for visible and cancellable neural observation.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio captures a screen only after you select it for visible and cancellable neural observation.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio sends keyboard input only when a brain action is permitted and visible in the action trace.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Omni AGI Studio uses system speech recognition only while Live Voice is active; unavailable recognizers are never simulated.
